question: Could you generate a report that shows the number of delivered orders for each month in the years 2016, 2017, and 2018? Each column represents a year, and each row represents a month
sql:
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2016 AND order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS "2016",
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017 AND order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS "2017",
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018 AND order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::INT AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2016, 2017, 2018)
GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY month
